## Summary

| status | crates | share of their downloads | meaning |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| builds | 41 / 273 (15.0%) | 15.3% | zurgo builds it and every dependency |
| build-fail | 5 / 273 (1.8%) | 2.1% | the check finds nothing, the build fails (code generation, linking) |
| blocked | 72 / 273 (26.4%) | 25.1% | its own code checks (or is not read), a dependency's does not |
| errors | 150 / 273 (54.9%) | 56.8% | zustc reports errors in its own code |

- Not probed: 19 proc-macro crates (rustc builds them for the host; the crates that use them test them) and 24 crates for other platforms.
- Errors zustc reports in the probes' graphs: **513** in 173 of 312 packages. A lower bound: zustc stops reading a crate at a syntax or macro error, and checks each function only up to its first error, so fixing one can show more.
